evidence.t: Road: Ealue Lake Rd, 4.8 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 19 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 37, Ealue Lake Rd.
Park: 57.8068, -129.74272, pull off on Ealue Lake Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Ealue Lake Rd stretch, 4.8 km one way. About 95 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-20, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-12, closures 2026-10-16.
